title: Jitambulishe kwa Kiingereza
objectives: Kujitambulisha: jina, unapotoka, na kazi yako
Kuuliza na kujibu maswali rahisi ya mazungumzo
Kutumia 'I am', 'I live in' na 'I work as' kwa usahihi

vocabulary.example: I live in Dar es Salaam.
I am a student at the university.

vocabulary.meaning: kitu unachopenda kufanya wakati wa mapumziko

vocabulary.example: It is good to meet you.
What do you do at the weekend?

phrases.english: How long have you lived here?
What do you like to do in your free time?
phrases.meaning: Unapenda kufanya nini wakati wa mapumziko?

phrases.english: It was nice talking to you.

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: Hello! My name is Juma. What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: Hi Juma, I am Asha. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: I am from Mwanza, but I live in Dar es Salaam now.

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: Oh, nice. What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: I work as a receptionist at a hotel in Posta. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: I am a student. I study accounting at the university.

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: That is great! What do you like to do at the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: I play football with my friends. What about you?

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: I like cooking and watching films with my family.

dialogue.speaker: Juma
dialogue.line: It was nice talking to you, Asha.

dialogue.speaker: Asha
dialogue.line: You too, Juma. See you later!

grammar.point: The verb 'to be': I am, you are, he/she is
grammar.explanation: Tunatumia 'am, is, are' kueleza sisi ni nani, tunatoka wapi, na hali yetu. 'I' huenda na 'am', 'he/she/it' huenda na 'is', na 'you/we/they' huenda na 'are'. Usiseme 'I student'; sema 'I am a student'. Pia kwa umri tunasema 'I am 24 years old', si 'I have 24 years'.
examples: We are happy to meet you.
They are students at the same college.

speaking_tasks: Jitambulishe kwa sentensi 4: jina lako, unapotoka, unapoishi, na kazi yako.
Muulize Mwalimu maswali 3 kuhusu yeye: unatoka wapi, unafanya kazi gani, unapenda kufanya nini.
Eleza unachofanya mwisho wa wiki kwa sentensi 3.
Maliza mazungumzo kwa adabu ukitumia 'It was nice talking to you.'
